verdict.rationale: Devin ships a first-party, documented CLI: a local command-line coding agent with Devin Cloud integration. The docs show an example invocation, an OS-level `--sandbox` flag, and handoff to cloud sessions, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented installation, auth and non-interactive scripting details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Devin CLI, a local command-line coding agent with deep Devin Cloud integration.
devin -- check out this code and suggest a feasible, helpful feature
The --sandbox flag runs the CLI with OS-level isolation, enforcing writable paths and deny rules at the operating-system level and optionally restricting network traffic.
